importantFindings.title: Still open: the deferred reopen still throws away a new student being typed when the instructor taps a Sesso option or taps the page to close the keyboard
importantFindings.evidence: src/backup/session.ts whenNotTyping: the EDITING selector excludes radio and checkbox, and a blur counts as 'not typing'. The new-student form (src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx) has no leave guard when student is null, so requestLeave passes straight through. Scratch spec on pixel-7: with the courses GET delayed 2.5 s, I filled Nome 'Bravo', Cognome 'Digitato' and Età '12', then tapped the first Sesso option. activeElement became INPUT/radio, the page navigated at about 5.7 s, the window marker was gone and Nome was empty. A second run, which filled the names and then tapped the 'Nuovo allievo' heading to close the keyboard, also reloaded once with an empty form. The repo test passes only because it keeps focus in a text field and then taps Annulla.
importantFindings.reproduction: Store a session on a local device with a course, reload with /rest/v1/courses delayed 2.5 s, go to Allievi > Aggiungi allievo, fill Nome, Cognome and Età, tap a Sesso option (or tap blank page) and wait 6 s. Expected: the form is kept, or the switch waits for the form to be saved or cancelled. Observed: the app reloads and the typed student is lost.

importantFindings.title: The deferred reopen raises 'Salva o annulla la nota prima di uscire.' on its own, and after that the reopen never happens
importantFindings.evidence: whenSafeToReopen calls requestLeave once nothing has had focus for 1.5 s. The Valutazioni guard (src/features/evaluations/EvaluationManagement.tsx:446-460) answers an open note with setHeldLeave('note') and keeps no leave callback. Scratch spec on pixel-7: student Aldo, session stored, courses GET delayed 4 s. I opened Aldo's note, typed 'Timone sicuro' and tapped an empty part of the page. After 8 s the red alert 'Salva o annulla la nota prima di uscire.' was visible and focused, although nobody had tried to leave. After Salva nota, the page still had not reloaded 5 s later (window marker intact). The resume promise stays pending, so later resumeBackup calls return early ('reopen').
importantFindings.reproduction: Open Valutazioni with an open note while the launch switch is pending, then tap outside the textarea and wait. Expected: no leave message, and the reopen waits silently until the note is closed. Observed: an unprompted 'before leaving' alert, and no reopen afterwards.

importantFindings.title: The screen asks for 'il codice dell'email', but no owner action exists to put a code in the email
importantFindings.evidence: OnlineBackup.tsx (link-sent state) says 'Se si apre altrove, scrivi qui il codice dell'email'. docs/working/OWNER_DECISIONS.md item 15 says the code 'needs one change in Supabase's email template (docs/OWNER_TODO.md)'. Neither docs/OWNER_TODO.md, .milestones/owner-checks.json nor docs/working/BACKEND_SETUP_0.5.0.md mentions the template, {{ .Token }} or a code. Until that change is made, an iPhone home-screen user or a Gmail in-app tab gets the expired-link notice, which points to a code the email does not contain.
